evaluation: same consumed validation; final remains unscored
feature_history: r1 squared, mean past 6 squared returns, mean past 12 squared returns; all unchanged across coefficient windows
basis_reason: Fixed quadratic permits asymmetric opening/closing level and broad curvature with two coefficients; no forced periodic endpoints. Discovery-only normalized intraday curve retained as descriptive support, not a live feature or basis search. No alternatives optimized on validation.
refit: once per session using prior-session matured labels
penalty: ridge 1, intercept unpenalized; standardization fitted independently on permitted training only
mixtures: equal 20/60 forecasts per bank at each declared floor; no adaptive weights
inference: paired mean daily losses, 2000 circular five-session block bootstrap draws; not search-adjusted
episode: report top-five contributions, best/worst days and monthly losses; keep all eligible days in primary results
positive_link: not run in initial factorial; if needed, separately freeze new exploratory family before fitting

nvda.fix: Predictor uses current/past NVDA bars only, no NVDA future target mask. QQQ alone determines target observability. Require contiguous historical intervals explicitly.
nvda.join: backward as-of, exact availability match tolerance0; same rows for all banks; +60s assumed release latency
nvda.lag: one additional 5min lag only; no lag grid or future shift
nvda.stop: If all corrected/lagged variants still lose to zero, discontinue this specification; do not use final data for it.

source_discovery_budget: At most 12 known date/index public objects plus source code/read-only repository evidence. No auth bypass, no source mutation, no prediction from unidentified quote ages.
